description: Two-step. 6a: introduce Host GenServer and supervision structure, wire bind_core to delegate (zero extension changes). 6b: add host: pid() to Context.t(), migrate the 4 action-using extensions to Host client calls. bind_core is NOT removed until Phase 9.

comments.text: Audit (2026-04-26): Host behaviour was defined and 4 extensions migrated to call Host.send_message(ctx.host, ...), but ctx.host was nil at runtime — every Context.new site in interactive.ex (lines 538, 552, 1149) sets ui: but never host:. Calls to GenServer.cast(nil, ...) raised ArgumentError silently caught by safe_call. Runtime wiring landed in opi-fin.14 (Session implements Host directly; no separate Host process).

title: Phase 6: Host GenServer replaces API action fn-fields
